findings.title: Migration Data Preservation Logic is Ambiguous
findings.problem: Doesn't specify what happens when users have no matching masterlist, duplicate student_ids, or email mismatches

findings.title: Encryption of Existing Data is Unspecified
findings.problem: No actual implementation of EncryptExistingData command provided. Says 'decrypt plain text initially' which doesn't work with Laravel encrypted casts
findings.impact: Migration will fail or corrupt data

findings.title: Encrypted Casting Column Type is Wrong
findings.problem: Design says columns should be TEXT but current schema has VARCHAR(255). Encrypted data exceeds this. No ALTER TABLE migration provided
findings.impact: Database errors when encrypted data truncated

findings.title: Login Flow Will Break Existing Sessions
findings.problem: New login uses masterlist relationship but existing tokens/sessions are tied to old structure. No token revocation specified

findings.title: Foreign Key Cascade Delete is Dangerous Without Safeguards
findings.problem: onDelete('cascade') specified but confirmation check is only in application code. Direct SQL deletion bypasses safeguards

findings.title: email_hash Column Missing from users Table Migration
findings.problem: Design mentions users.email_hash as alternative but never specifies if it's implemented. Ambiguous whether login searches masterlist or users table

findings.title: Rollback Procedure Cannot Restore Encrypted Data to Plaintext
findings.problem: Says rollback 'repopulates columns from masterlist' but if data is encrypted, this won't give plaintext. Contradictory statements about rollback being destructive vs working
findings.impact: Rollback will fail or restore encrypted data to wrong columns

findings.title: Register API Contract Breaking Change Not Documented for Frontend
findings.problem: Backend removes fname/lname/email from validation but frontend currently sends them. No backward compatibility or explicit rejection specified
findings.impact: Registration will fail with unclear errors

findings.title: Accessor Methods Don't Handle Null Masterlist Relationship
findings.problem: Accessors return null when masterlist missing but existing code expects strings. Will cause string concatenation issues and silent failures
findings.impact: Runtime errors in activity logs and user displays

findings.title: Migration Ordering Dependencies Not Specified
findings.problem: Multiple migrations mentioned with contradictory timestamps. No clear execution order. Missing migration for 'address' column

findings.title: Email Hash Collision Risk Not Addressed
findings.problem: No unique constraint specified on email_hash. No collision handling despite being theoretically possible

findings.title: Performance Impact of Encrypted Searches Not Quantified
findings.problem: Says 'must load all records and filter in PHP' but no benchmarks, memory estimates, or scale limits specified
findings.impact: Unknown if solution scales to production data volume

findings.title: Suffix Validation Inconsistency
findings.problem: Frontend shows ['Jr.', 'Sr.', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'] but backend shows 'Jr.,Sr.,Sr,Jr,II,III,IV,V' with duplicates and inconsistent formatting

findings.title: Region Dropdown Hardcoded List Will Break if Philippines Adds Regions
findings.problem: 17 regions hardcoded in frontend JavaScript. No backend validation. Historical precedent shows regions change
findings.impact: Requires frontend updates for configuration changes

findings.title: Testing Strategy Missing Database State Verification
findings.problem: High-level test descriptions but no specific assertions about database state, encryption verification, or constraint enforcement
findings.impact: Tests may pass while critical issues remain

verifiedAssumptions: User model fillable fields match design
Masterlist model fillable fields match design
Current database schema matches described structure
UserController checks masterlist before user creation
wrongAssumptions: users table has 'address' column - it doesn't exist in current migration
Laravel encrypted casting can encrypt plaintext by re-saving - requires manual encryption first
Rollback can repopulate from encrypted masterlist - needs decryption logic
